items.title: FTAPI confirms breach after 'The Gentlemen' ransomware gang claims data theft
items.summary: The German secure file-transfer platform said attackers reached one internal server, not customer systems or transferred data. The gang's leak-site countdown shows about 5 days before the alleged leak entry activates.

items.title: BrainCipher ransomware attack on Gold Star Mortgage triggers customer lawsuit within 48 hours
items.summary: The Michigan mortgage lender was hit on September 23 with data theft followed by database encryption; a borrower sued on September 26 alleging her SSN and personal data appeared on the dark web.

items.title: MI5 issues first public espionage alert over Chinese spy web targeting 100 UK academics
items.summary: The agency warned universities to end all engagement with the China Academy of General Technology, saying research collaborations in AI, cybersecurity and steganography were feeding China's intelligence services.

items.title: Critical WordPress core RCE (CVE-2026-87902) actively exploited days after patch
items.summary: Versions 4.7.0 through 7.1.1 are affected by the unauthenticated template-inclusion flaw; WordPress released fixes on September 22 and exploitation attempts began within hours.

items.title: Ransomware groups exploiting TeamCity auth-bypass CVE-2026-63077; 160+ servers still unpatched
items.summary: JetBrains' unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in TeamCity On-Premises is now being exploited by ransomware crews, with Shadowserver tracking over 160 exposed, unpatched servers as of September 28.

items.title: MedImpact notifies breach victims 11 months after Qilin ransomware attack
items.summary: The pharmacy benefit manager began mailing individual notices on September 23 for unauthorized activity detected October 18, 2025; exposed data includes names, Social Security numbers and health information.
